answer.reason: Two marked verses (JER 43:13, EZK 30:17) state what was foretold to befall the city, which goes beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was foretold to have its images broken and its gods' houses burned with fire
clauses.quote: He shall break also the images of Bethshemesh

clauses.english: was foretold to see its young men fall by the sword and the city go into captivity
clauses.quote: The young men of Aven and of Pibeseth shall fall by the sword

doubts: JER 43:13 calls the city Bethshemesh and EZK 30:17 calls it Aven; the verses given do not say these are On, so the match rests on the marking.
GEN 41:45, GEN 41:50 and GEN 46:20 only name Asenath's father as priest of On, which is a relation, so they are left out.
